scope: Independent visual review of source-keys.png, design.png, revisions/keys-v2.png and source.json; four chronological still keys only. No playback or interpolation approval.

timed_key_evidence.evidence: The butterfly perches on a raised fingertip with an upright near-closed wing silhouette. Loop antenna tips echo the selected design, but the wing is divided into a conspicuous chain of enclosed vein cells absent from that design.
The perch and near-closed wings persist with only a small angle change; the short legs meet the fingertip region rather than implying flight.
The hand and butterfly move lower and left together, maintaining their contact. The wing remains a long narrow side silhouette, with the interior cellular pattern dominating its drawing vocabulary.
The subject remains attached to the fingertip with upright folded wings. No full spread, flap or takeoff has been substituted for the source action.

consequential_gap: The source action and support are preserved, but the revision replaces the selected sparse, mostly empty lobed-wing doodle with an extensively subdivided naturalistic wing. The chosen drawing is less recognizable than its loop antennae alone suggest.
bounded_repair: Change only the butterfly wings in all four keys: retain their present near-closed angle, scale and perch, remove the enclosed vein-cell network, and express the folded pair using a sparse angular outer contour with the selected design's gentle two-lobe notch and at most one overlap line.
protected_strengths: Continuous fingertip perch and coherent short-leg attachment.
Subtle wing-angle changes without invented takeoff or full flap.
Loop-ended antennae and the hand position track consistently across the four keys.
